title: Where does the first Opus click land?
fullTitle: Opus Pre-Skip 312: Rewrite One Header Field, the Click Moves 312 Samples

scenes.narration: Opus files carry a pre-skip: three hundred twelve samples in this encode. What does the decoder do with it? One click, at sample forty eight hundred. Where does it come back?
captions: Pre-skip 312. Where does the click come back?

scenes.narration: One second, forty eight thousand samples. Libopus at sixty four kilobits, into o g g, m k v, and dot opus. Control: through P C M, the click stays at forty eight hundred. Readers: decoded samples, file bytes, f f probe.
captions: Control: through PCM, the click stays at 4800.
Readers: decoded samples, file bytes, ffprobe.

scenes.narration: The bytes: Opus Head, then three eight zero one. Little endian: three hundred twelve samples, six point five milliseconds. The m k v repeats it as codec delay. F f probe calls it initial padding. In all four files, the click is at forty eight hundred.

Now lie. Rewrite only that field, and fix the page checksum. Pre-skip zero: the click lands at fifty one twelve, three hundred twelve late. Pre-skip one thousand: forty one twelve, six hundred eighty eight early. The header decides.

Cut with dash s s zero point five and dash c copy. M k v, before the input: nine hundred sixty samples early. After it: exact. O g g after the input: nine hundred sixty late. Copies land on twenty millisecond packets. O g g with default pages, before the input: nothing is cut.
captions: Default ogg pages, -ss before -i: nothing cut.

scenes.narration: Re-encode instead, with dash s s or dash a f a trim: the first click lands at twenty four thousand, exact. But a trim leaves six hundred forty eight extra samples at the end.
captions: atrim: 648 extra samples at the end.

scenes.narration: The decoder trims exactly what the header says. After any cut, read the pre-skip and find the click. Not tested: other builds, real players, other encoders, real music.
captions: The header decides. Find the click after a cut.
Not tested: players, other encoders, real music.
